concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
negative_en: 3D render look, broken facial features, fake-looking background, body distortion, illustration look, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, plastic-looking skin, cartoon style
prompt_en: A photographic scene of a fictional adult woman in a candid moment at an almost empty night roller rink beside the skate-return counter. Her face and hair are guided by the attached portrait: a short dark bob with fine parted bangs, a softly rounded facial contour, dark eyes and naturally pink lips. She glides left to right through her last slow lap, turning her head toward her rink-edge friend who is taking this photograph. A small, unguarded smile and the loose swing of her open slate satin blouson make the farewell feel close and spontaneous; an ivory fitted knit tank and dark tapered trousers belong naturally to the evening. Both quad-skate wheel sets meet the smooth floor, feet slightly staggered beneath softly bent knees, with her left arm held loosely outward for balance. The return counter and stacked rental skates mark where her glide is carrying her. Photograph her full body from nearby at chest height, with her face large enough to read and both skates inside the frame. The main impression is a compact-digital direct-flash snapshot: hard frontal flash makes a crisp bright edge on her cheek and jacket folds, with a short dark floor shadow behind her skates and a dimmer rink. Slow-sync flash freezes one sharp body while a faint continuous exposure trail follows her moving sleeve and wheels toward screen left; Small cyan LEDs in the skate wheels leave short horizontal light streaks toward screen left behind the flash-frozen wheels; fixed rails and counter edges stay still. Fine digital luma noise and scattered tiny green-magenta chroma speckles are visibly strongest across the dark wall and shaded jacket folds, fading into the bright face. Keep skin texture, satin reflections and floor contact readable.
